summary_1line: Saraswati instructs Tarkshya on virtuous conduct and the heavenly rewards of Vedic study and charitable gifts, especially the donation of cows.

image_candidates.scene_text: The sage Sanatkumara teaches assembled rishis that the power of Brahmanas and Kshatriyas together burns enemies like wind-fed fire in a forest.
King Vainya joyfully presents heaps of gold coins and ornaments to the sage Atri after being praised before the gathered sages.
The goddess Saraswati speaks to the sage Tarkshya beside serene celestial lakes filled with golden lilies and surrounded by radiant apsaras.
